task: Separate experimental classifiers imitate selected existing rule outcomes; not clinical safety, optimal prescribing or dose generation
selection: macro F1 on novel unique validation inputs; stable declared order on ties; no test selection or validation refit
coverage: Four existing exact reference products; paracetamol's existing additional measles/mumps research mappings reused. Other products remain unsupported.
allergy: Reuse selected ingredient/cross-hypersensitivity checks. No match means only no selected match, never allergy clearance; excipients and comprehensive cross-reactivity are absent.
interaction: Reuse current-medicine and oseltamivir LAIV cautions. Known current medicine pairs require review; unresolved pairs cannot validate. Paracetamol/warfarin remains a review caution, not an invented contraindication. No comprehensive interaction database.
dose: Reuse reference_regimen and validate_dose with explicit fictional proposals. Learn matches_selected_rule/mismatch/cannot_validate; never learn or generate an unverified numeric dose. No regimen when prerequisites/product scope are missing.
purpose_applicability: Mapped symptom purpose: any explicitly present target is provisionally relevant, all absent not_relevant, otherwise cannot_validate. Mapped antivirals require fictional assessed standard outpatient context, an explicit supported guideline/risk pathway and selected onset window. WHO non-severe oseltamivir is guideline_against; unknown/severe WHO contexts are unsupported, not extrapolated.
best_medicine: No optimal-medicine or preference ground truth is created. Preserve purpose/clinical role; show a tied shortlist only after deterministic checks. Each implemented condition-role group has one product, so meaningful within-group ranking cannot be measured.
source_200: Audit separately without promoting unverified reports, inventing missing facts, assigning an exact product to a generic candidate or adding a proposed dose. Do not train on this audit.
operational_safety: Offline synthetic fixtures only. Production checks, history, reviews and models unchanged. ML cannot clear a block, unknown, missing review or unsupported product.
feature_policy: Task-specific allowlists of raw fictional inputs only. Exclude outcome labels, checks, reasons, references, teacher scores, IDs, families, splits, proposal-generation mode, reviews and post-decision fields. Fit preprocessing on unique training inputs only.
